title: VaNGuard assay protocol for SARS-CoV-2 detection
protocol: Add 8.3 µL of heat-inactivated NP swab samples to the tube.
Vortex for 1 minute.
Heat inactivate Proteinase K at 95°C for 5 minutes.
Use 2 μL of treated sample for RT-LAMP amplification.
Prepare 10X SARS-CoV-2 S primer mix with water, F3, B3, FIP(PM), BIP(PM), FIP(tPM-1), BIP(tPM-1), LF, LB, swarm F1c, and swarm B1c as specified in the protocol.
Prepare 10X ACTB primer mix with water, F3, B3, FIP, BIP, LF, and LB as specified in the protocol.
Dilute 3 µL of Q5 Polymerase at 2U/µL with 99 µL of water to achieve a concentration of 0.06 U/µL.

Setup RT-LAMP reaction in a 0.2 mL PCR strip tube with components as specified: 10X SARS-CoV-2 S primer mix, 10X ACTB primer mix, 0.4M Guanidine HCl, Q5 Polymerase (0.06 U/µL), water, LAMP dye, and WarmStart LAMP mastermix.
Pipette 2 µL of Proteinase K-treated NP swab samples into the assembled reaction.
Incubate final reaction at 65°C for 22 minutes.
Pre-complex Cas12a RNP by mixing 0.75 µL of S2(+4DNA)(5µM), 0.75 µL of S6(+4DNA)(5µM) and 7.5 µL of enAsCas12a(100ng/µL).
Incubate RNP at 37°C for at least 15 minutes.
Prepare RNP-probe mix with 32 µL of water, 7.5 µL of 10X Tango Buffer, 1.5 µL of Cy5-Quencher reporter(10µM) and 9 µL of complexed RNP.
Pipette 50 µL of Cas12a-probe mix directly into RT-LAMP products.
Incubate reaction mix at 60°C for 5 minutes.

Prepare 10X SARS-CoV2 S primer mix with 22 µL of water, 2 µL of F3(100µM), 4 µL of B3(100µM), 8 µL of FIP(PM)(100µM), 8 µL of BIP(PM)(100µM), 8 µL of FIP(tPM-1)(100µM), 8 µL of BIP(tPM-1)(100µM), 4 µL of LF(100µM) and 4 µL of LB(100µM), 16 µL of swarm F1c(100µM) and 16 µL of swarm B1c.
Dilute 3 µL of Q5 Polymerase at 2U/µL with 99 µL of water to create a working solution.

Setup RT-LAMP reaction in a 0.2mL PCR strip tube with 2.5µL of 10X SARS-CoV2 S primer mix, 2.5µL of 0.4M Guanidine HCl, 2.5µL of Q5 Polymerase (0.06U/μl), 3μl of water and 12.5μl of WarmStart LAMP mastermix.
Pipette 2μl of Proteinase K-treated NP swab samples into the assembled reaction.
Incubate final reaction at 65ºC for 22 minutes.
Pre-complex Cas12a RNP by mixing 0.75μL of S2(+4DNA)(5μM), 0.75μL of S6(+4DNA)(5μM) and 7.5μL of enAsCas12a (100ng/μl).
Incubate RNP at 37ºC for 30 minutes.
Prepare Cas12a-probe mix with 20μL of water, 7.5μL of 10X Tango Buffer, 13.5μL of FAM-Biotin reporter(500nM) and 9μL of complexed RNP.
Pipette 50μl of RNP-probe mix directly into RT-LAMP products.
Incubate reaction mix at 60ºC for 5 minutes.
Pipette 75μl of HybriDetect assay buffer (Milenia Biotec) into the reaction mix.
Insert dipstick into reaction mix in an upright position.
Allow reaction to flow up the flow strip for 2 minutes before inspection.
